参考/身份锁定
使用参考图1作为成年男性间谍的精确身份锁定。全程保持完全相同的脸、面部比例、黑色发型、肤色、体格、服装和配饰。不得改变身份或服装。

15秒电影感动作——24FPS，实时
照片级真实好莱坞间谍动作，ARRI Alexa Mini，27mm球面镜头，4K，24fps，真实物理，锐利电影胶片颗粒，激进手持摄影，动态跟拍，甩镜，低角度战斗镜头和真实运动模糊。9:16竖屏。

环境
继续在同一个浸满油的工业工厂内。浓烟、闪烁的青白色荧光灯、火花、蒸汽喷发、碎玻璃、损坏的机器、覆满油污的混凝土、倒下的敌人、油桶、传送带、钢柱、桥式起重机和架空平台。保持完美连续性。

0–4秒：最后一声枪响后，两名武装增援人员从钢制安全门冲入，另一名敌人从桥式起重机索降。间谍立即向前冲刺，踩上一个倒下的木箱，腾空侧踢，将敌人6撞进钢门。他无缝接一个旋转旋风踢，将敌人7从索降绳上踢进堆叠的油桶。

4–7秒：敌人8开自动火。间谍在枪火下翻滚，左手拔出战斗刀，砍中武器手臂并缴械。他锁住手腕，以精准的功夫步法转身，将敌人8过肩摔，并以一记有力的下劈斧踢终结。

7–10秒：警报启动，一名身穿重甲、持防弹盾牌的特工冲来。间谍向他冲刺，从钢柱上反弹，进行短距离跑墙，腾空自行车踢，将盾牌踢向上方。他落在特工身后，执行快速臂锁、肘击、膝击和旋转后踢，将他穿过钢栏杆送到下层。

10–13秒：高架平台上的敌人开火。间谍躲到移动传送带后，从下面滑过，通过狭窄缝隙快速射出四发战术射击，消灭两名攻击者。他现身，抓住悬挂的工业链条，荡过机械间隙，腾空双脚踢向最后一名攻击者，将他砸穿强化安全玻璃。

13–15秒：间谍以受控的三点着地姿势落地。红色应急灯取代荧光灯。他身后一条巨大的燃料管道破裂，形成真实的冲天火墙。他没有回头，平静地转向黑暗的工业走廊。短暂电影感推近，然后在15秒硬切黑。

摄影/灯光：激进手持晃动摄影，快速推轨跟拍，快速甩镜，动态低角度，近距离过肩镜头，真实摄影机惯性。青白色工业照明过渡为闪烁红色应急灯和真实橙色火光。浓烟、火花、蒸汽、枪口闪光和真实碎片。

物理：扎实的功夫编排，真实人体重量、动量、冲击和布娃娃行为。无钢丝功夫或超级英雄动作。武器和身体保持物理一致。

负面提示：无慢动作、延时、子弹时间、梦幻效果、超级英雄动作、不真实物理、夸张钢丝功夫、不可能跑酷、糟糕解剖、扭曲脸、身份变化、服装变化、CGI伪影、抖动、重影、重复肢体、武器穿模、瞬移、不真实爆炸、假玻璃破碎、连续性错误或电子游戏动作。

最终：15秒，9:16，24fps，4K，照片级真实好莱坞动作，电影感真实，锐利胶片颗粒。

extra-254b9a90c9b5.zh-Hans: MAIN WARRIOR是一名完全原创、无法对应任何现成人物的明确成年男性，约四十多至五十岁，高大、极其强壮，饱经风霜的橄榄色皮肤，肩长深色湿发，浓密深色胡须夹杂灰丝，眉骨深刻，面部有污垢、汗水与疲惫痕迹。穿原创古铜色胸甲，腹部只有非标志性雕塑甲片、圆钝分层肩甲、深色皮革裙甲、青铜护臂、厚重战靴与低饱和深红色斗篷；不戴头盔。脸、胡须、污迹、盔甲、披风和身体比例全程完全一致。  LUMINOUS WOMAN是明确成年女性，二十多至三十多岁，中等橄榄色皮肤，齐肩湿黑发，运动型曲线体型；穿原创象牙色与沙色垂坠服装，包含完全不透明贴身内层、编织腰部结构和长半透明布片。服装始终安全贴合、解剖稳定，脸、头发、服装与体型全程不变。  COLOSSAL CREATURE是原创非IP巨型人形生物，巨大尺度，秃头、灰褐色拉伸皮肤、可见肋骨与锁骨、两只暗红色发光眼、细长骨性下颌、不规则尖牙、极长双臂、巨大有明确关节的双手和树干粗细的双腿；皮肤是肉质革状，不是树皮。体型、两眼、肢体数量和尺度全程稳定。  所有人物与生物完全独立，身份、脸、肢体、衣物、武器必须始终清晰，绝不融合、换脸、多肢体、共享手脚或比例漂移。船员、牧羊战士、被俘防御者与两名斧战士全部是彼此不同的明确成年人。羊群始终保持同一群淡色羊。  风格：精确20.00秒，横向原生16:9，24fps，照片级真实VFX增强真人神话奇幻预告片，必须像真实摄影成人演员、真实布料和实际盔甲，与写实海洋、船体和巨型生物VFX无缝合成；允许高端奇幻概念艺术与顶级游戏电影审美影响，但绝不能变成动漫、插画、赛璐璐着色、2.5D或统一光泽CG。摄影模拟ARRI Alexa 35、35mm Cooke变形镜头，冷青/蓝对暖琥珀，青铜高光、深红点缀、克制泛光与光晕、细腻有机颗粒、轻微暗角。动作自然时间，约180度快门，只有高速身体、羊、船体冲击、前景遮挡有真实方向模糊。  镜头规则：一个连续镜头，无剪切、无跳切、无黑场剪辑、无蒙太奇。摄影机必须通过墙面、烟雾、船帆、人物身体、白色曝光泛光、水花与黑暗前景遮挡，在一个连续空间化电影镜头中依次进入所有视觉段落。优先侧面与背侧观察，不做英雄定格，不做干净宣传构图。  0.00-1.78秒：从MAIN WARRIOR中长景开始，他站在深青蓝色墙前，左侧侧脸，双臂沉重下垂，深红斗篷挂在肩后。眼睛先转，随后下巴、颈部和上躯干跟随，腿保持扎地；最终几乎正对镜头，形成疲惫、敌意的直接凝视。左上硬光在画面右侧墙面投下清楚影子。约1.42-1.54秒短暂用白色曝光泛光扫过人物与墙面，但不是剪切，姿态不改变。  1.78-3.48秒：白泛光扩张并化成海面高光，摄影机连续进入极高俯视深青色海洋。窄木船带一面深红色矩形帆，沿巨大漩涡外缘受旋流侧拉，白色尾迹弯曲，右侧浪撞炭灰色悬崖。镜头下降靠近船体后被红帆遮挡，帆布擦镜转回MAIN WARRIOR极近脸部；他低头、呼吸、眉头收紧，湿发成束贴额，浅景深背景仍为青色。  3.48-5.03秒：摄影机被他的肩部带回船上，从至少六名成年船员后方沿湿甲板前看。船体剧烈俯仰，众人屈膝抓栏杆，右前景大个船员宽站稳。水花和红布扫镜后自然显出LUMINOUS WOMAN全身站在蓝白色雾中，背后强白光源形成径向光束。她髋部缓慢转移重心，一脚微向前，肩部反向平衡，一手放松长象牙色布片，布料延迟飘动。约4.95-5.03秒让一块极暗前景布料完全遮镜两帧，但摄影机仍持续运动，绝不变成剪辑黑场。  5.03-7.80秒：暗布掠开回到船甲板低侧角。船猛然倾斜，一名戴头盔男子落到一膝一手后在湿木板滑动，另一人右侧摔倒，其他人抓住舷墙；水冲过中右甲板。摄影机贴地穿过脚与水花，盔甲靴与裸小腿踉跄，木桅杆沿船体滑动。随后一道白色浪花曝光遮镜，连续转入MAIN WARRIOR正面中长景，他僵硬站立、浅呼吸、直视前方，约5.92-6.05秒出现短白过曝照明。镜头继续从他肩侧移出，再被蓝白雾包围，LUMINOUS WOMAN完成一次清楚向前迈步：脚落地、膝髋转移重量、躯干跟上，湿发和象牙色拖尾延迟摆动。  7.80-10.82秒：她的长布料扫过镜头，转成琥珀色尘雾外景。数名成年牧羊战士与淡色羊群从低位宽景朝镜头跑来，脚步、羊蹄、尘土全部自然高速。近镜一只羊短暂遮挡，遮挡退开时摄影机高抬回到漩涡，红帆船更靠近旋涡唇，白泡沫旋入黑暗中心。海雾擦镜后再次出现女人三分之二全身，她完成一次头与躯干连续转身，头先到方向，湿黑发在背光中水平甩开，象牙色拖尾围腿延迟旋转。  10.82-13.57秒：白布边缘化成烟雾琥珀色荒原。COLOSSAL CREATURE从暗处俯身，一只巨大开放手掌朝镜头伸来，五指各自关节稳定；右下方是一名正常体型成年戴头盔防御者。巨手横扫并牢牢包住其躯干，不穿透盔甲，将其完全提离地面，双腿弯曲后悬空摆动。巨人把他向张开的嘴方向带近，但在任何咬合或伤害前摄影机沿巨臂滑到其巨大下腿。两名不同成年斧战士一左一右，以双手长柄武器攻击同一条肉质巨腿：右侧先髋转击脚踝，近镜一只深色羊横穿遮挡，随后左侧战士举起武器下劈，右侧收回再击小腿下部。动作有脚底接地、肩髋旋转和尘土后果，无血、无切断。摄影机迅速后撤露出正好六名成年幸存者朝镜头奔跑，巨人在烟后推进，淡色羊在右后方跑，小火在左中闪烁。  13.57-16.36秒：一块极暗烟尘完全遮住镜头约两帧但摄影机不停，随后从上方看见LUMINOUS WOMAN，她巨大的象牙色裙在蓝白色地面上形成花状螺旋，斜光切出明暗褶皱。她单臂支撑，另一臂向后，缓慢抬下巴直视上方摄影机，裙摆外缘仍继续波动。白色高光逐渐扩张并转成更近的站立中景，她略后仰，双手在腰后握住拖布，呼吸一次，眼睛短暂下垂再回到镜头。  16.36-20.00秒：蓝白雾转为青色墙面，完整全身MAIN WARRIOR重新出现，双脚肩宽、双臂下垂、斗篷不对称垂落，只有呼吸与细布料运动。摄影机绕到其右侧侧脸，留出前方空青色空间；他咬紧下颌、眼睛做一次微小调整。随后摄影机沿侧后弧线转向前方，他突然把头与上肩转向镜头，脚与下身仍完全稳定；湿发、胡须和肩甲产生短促真实方向模糊。动作停住后摄影机持续快速推进，从上躯干一路逼到极近脸部，清楚显示毛孔、汗、嵌入皱褶的灰尘、湿发束和灰胡须细节。20.00秒精确结束在活着、持续呼吸、没有眨眼的敌意凝视上，无淡出、无冻结、无标题。  声音：只有现场音效，无任何音乐、无人声对白、无旁白。战士段有近距离呼吸、甲片皮革细响和空间低风；海洋段有浪涛、漩涡低频吸力、船体呻吟、索具绷紧、帆布抽响、甲板撞击和水冲声；羊群段有尘土脚步、羊蹄与非语言动物声；巨人段有深呼吸、远低吼、巨大脚步和地面共振；两次脚踝攻击有清楚但非血腥的金属撞击肉质低响。最后推进只保留贴近战士的呼吸、甲胄细响与远处空气低鸣，20.00秒声音同步停止。  强制限制：严格保持MAIN WARRIOR与LUMINOUS WOMAN为同两名成年人；战士脸、污垢、胡须、发型、盔甲和深红斗篷不变；女人湿黑发和象牙色服装不变；船员、被俘者与斧战士始终是不同成年人；红帆船、漩涡地理、船体材质、羊群与巨人生理解剖全程稳定；巨人只用一只手抓一名被俘者躯干，被俘者严格两臂两腿；脚踝段严格两名战士、两件长柄武器、一条巨腿；无咬伤、无血、无血腥、无logo、无水印、无字幕、无文字；动作必须有重量、惯性、反冲、布料跟随、环境反应与真实重力。
extra-254b9a90c9b5.en: MAIN WARRIOR is a fully original male who cannot correspond to any existing character, clearly an adult male, roughly forty to fifty years old, tall, extremely strong, weathered olive skin, shoulder-length dark wet hair, thick dark beard mixed with gray strands, deep brow ridge, face with dirt, sweat and traces of exhaustion. Wearing an original antiqued-bronze cuirass, abdomen with only non-emblematic sculpted plates, rounded layered pauldrons, dark leather skirt armor, bronze bracers, heavy boots and a low-saturation dark-crimson cloak; no helmet. Face, beard, grime, armor, cloak and body proportions remain completely consistent throughout.  LUMINOUS WOMAN is a clearly adult woman, twenty to thirty-plus years old, medium olive skin, shoulder-length wet black hair, athletic-curved build; wearing an original ivory and sand-colored draped costume, including a fully opaque fitted inner layer, woven waist structure and long semi-sheer fabric panels. The costume always fits safely and is anatomically stable; face, hair, costume and body type remain unchanged throughout.  COLOSSAL CREATURE is an original non-IP giant humanoid creature, enormous scale, bald, gray-brown stretched skin, visible ribs and collarbones, two muted-red glowing eyes, elongated bony lower jaw, irregular sharp teeth, extremely long arms, huge hands with clearly defined joints and tree-trunk-thick legs; the skin is fleshy leather-like, not bark. Body type, two eyes, number of limbs and scale remain stable throughout.  All characters and the creature are completely independent; identity, face, limbs, clothing, weapons must always be clear, never fused, never face-swapped, no extra limbs, no shared hands or feet, no proportion drift. The crew, shepherd-warriors, captive defender and two axe fighters are all distinct clearly adult individuals. The flock always remains the same group of pale sheep.  Style: exactly 20.00 seconds, horizontal native 16:9, 24fps, photoreal VFX-enhanced live-action mythological fantasy trailer, must look like real photographed adult actors, real fabric and actual armor, seamlessly composited with realistic ocean, ship hull and giant creature VFX; high-end fantasy concept-art and prestige game-cinematic aesthetic influence is allowed, but it must never become anime, illustration, cel shading, 2.5D or uniform glossy CG. Cinematography simulates ARRI Alexa 35, 35mm Cooke anamorphic, cool teal/blue against warm amber, bronze highlights, dark-crimson accents, restrained bloom and halation, fine organic grain, slight vignette. Motion in natural time, approximately 180-degree shutter, real directional blur only on high-speed bodies, sheep, hull impacts and foreground occlusions.  Camera rules: one continuous shot, no cuts, no jump cuts, no black-frame edits, no montage. The camera must pass through walls, smoke, sails, character bodies, white exposure bloom, water spray and dark foreground occlusions, entering all visual passages sequentially within one continuous spatialized cinematic shot. Favor side and rear-side observation, no hero poses, no clean promotional compositions.  0.00-1.78 seconds: Start with a medium-long shot of MAIN WARRIOR, standing in front of a deep teal-blue wall, left-side profile, arms hanging heavily, crimson cloak hanging behind his shoulders. His eyes turn first, then chin, neck and upper torso follow, legs stay planted; finally almost directly facing camera, forming an exhausted, hostile direct stare. Hard upper-left light casts a clear shadow on the screen-right wall. At about 1.42-1.54 seconds a brief white exposure bloom sweeps across the character and wall, but it is not a cut, and the pose does not change.  1.78-3.48 seconds: The white bloom expands and dissolves into sea-surface highlights; the camera continuously enters an extremely high overhead view of dark teal ocean. A narrow wooden boat with one dark-red rectangular sail is pulled sideways by the swirl along the outer rim of a giant whirlpool, white wake curving, waves on the right crashing against charcoal cliffs. The camera descends close to the hull and is then occluded by the red sail; the canvas brushes the lens and turns back to an extreme close-up of MAIN WARRIOR's face; he looks down, breathes, brow tightens, wet hair clings in strands to his forehead, shallow depth of field background still teal.  3.48-5.03 seconds: The camera is carried back onto the ship by his shoulder, looking forward along the wet deck from behind at least six adult crew members. The hull pitches violently, everyone bends knees and grabs railings, a large crew member in the right foreground stands wide and stable. After water spray and red cloth sweep the lens, LUMINOUS WOMAN naturally appears full-body standing in blue-white fog, a strong white source behind her forming radial light beams. She slowly shifts weight at the hips, one foot slightly forward, shoulders counterbalancing, one hand loosely holding a long ivory fabric panel, the cloth drifting with delay. At about 4.95-5.03 seconds let an extremely dark foreground cloth fully occlude the lens for two frames, but the camera keeps moving, never becoming an editorial black frame.  5.03-7.80 seconds: The dark cloth sweeps away back to a low side angle of the ship deck. The ship lurches violently; a helmeted man lands on one knee and one hand then slides on wet planks, another falls on the right, others grab the bulwark; water rushes across the center-right deck. The camera hugs the ground through feet and spray, armor boots and bare calves stagger, a wooden spar slides along the hull. Then a white spray exposure covers the lens, continuously transitioning into a frontal medium-long shot of MAIN WARRIOR, standing rigidly, shallow breathing, staring straight ahead, with a brief white overexposure illumination at about 5.92-6.05 seconds. The camera continues moving out from his shoulder side, then is surrounded by blue-white fog, LUMINOUS WOMAN completes one clear forward step: foot lands, knee and hip transfer weight, torso follows, wet hair and ivory train swing with delay.  7.80-10.82 seconds: Her long fabric sweeps across the lens, turning into an amber dust-haze exterior. Several adult shepherd-warriors and a flock of pale sheep run toward camera from a low wide shot, footsteps, sheep hooves, dust all naturally high-speed. A sheep briefly occludes in close shot; as the occlusion clears the camera rises high back to the whirlpool, the red-sailed boat closer to the whirlpool lip, white foam spiraling into the dark center. After sea mist brushes the lens, the woman appears again in a two-thirds full-body shot; she completes one continuous head-and-torso turn, head arrives at the direction first, wet black hair whips horizontally in backlight, ivory train rotates around her legs with delay.  10.82-13.57 seconds: The edge of the white cloth dissolves into a smoky amber wasteland. COLOSSAL CREATURE bends down from the darkness, one huge open palm reaching toward camera, five fingers each with stable joints; lower-right is a normal-sized adult helmeted defender. The giant hand sweeps across and firmly wraps around his torso without penetrating the armor, lifting him completely off the ground, legs bending then dangling and swinging. The giant brings him toward the open mouth, but before any bite or harm the camera slides along the giant arm down to its huge lower leg. Two distinct adult axe fighters, one left one right, attack the same fleshy giant leg with two-handed long-hafted weapons: the right one first rotates hips to strike the ankle, a dark sheep crosses in close shot as occlusion, then the left fighter raises weapon and chops down, the right one retracts and strikes the lower shin again. Action has foot grounding, shoulder-hip rotation and dust consequences, no blood, no severing.
